notes.title: Land of the Crescent 2024 Broadcast
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/69c3f16a8bd891804693658eaff5b061fa6063fb.png[/img]
[b]Land of the Crescent: Games from Türkiye[/b] aims to celebrate the versatility and hard work of Türkiye’s video game development community over the last decades. [b]Pawn of the Dead [/b]is a part of this event.

Ahmet Kamil Keleş (lead developer of the game) will be playing it in a live Let's Play to celebrate this event. It will be broadcast in Steam and Aslan Game Studio's [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCWMF51_LhE_b9fHAoCSjrxQ]YouTube channel[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/aslangamestudio]Facebook page[/url].

notes.title: Remote Play Together Fest livestream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/cb654f3a1a52a3174acdc2720649aff8fab2e127.jpg[/img]

Pawn of the Dead will be a part of Steam's Remote Play Together Fest, which will be held during Feb 12-19.

Our Steam live stream is on Sunday, [b]Feb 18 2024 GMT 16:30 (TSİ 19:30).[/b] We will be celebrating the anniversary of Pawn of the Dead's Steam release, as well.

notes.title: Patch (February 2024)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/7fef3cc95b84df8dcb1f713db4557502c73f6e4a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/cb654f3a1a52a3174acdc2720649aff8fab2e127.jpg[/img]

Pawn of the Dead has a better gamepad support now. Issues about DualSense has been solved. At right upper corner, correct gamepad glyphs are shown. Gamepad can rumble, too!

Also, improvements on visuals, optimization are made and some minor bugs are fixed.

notes.title: Native Silicon support for macOS, Improvements for Linux
notes.content:
[b]macOS[/b]
Pawn of the Dead supports Silicon processors (M1, M2, etc.) natively now. It could already run on Macs with Silicon processors before, though, this update is about performance upgrade.

[b]Linux[/b]
Pawn of the Dead's Linux port is built with IL2CPP backend, it was Mono before. And Vulkan works better (you can use -force-vulkan parameter to open the game with that). This update is about performance, as well.

[b]Windows [/b]build didn't need any change.

notes.title: Gamepad support and more optimization
notes.content: This patch provides full gamepad support for Pawn of the Dead. Also, we optimized the game more.

notes.title: "Restart the level" suggestion when you lose an important piece
notes.content: Now in Chapter 1, the game suggests you to restart the game if you lose an important piece.

notes.title: Pawn of the Dead is a fun Zombie twist on Chess in the style of Battle Chess
notes.content:
Love Chess but want something a little different? Pawn of the Dead seems like it could be exactly what you want.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/06/pawn-of-the-dead-is-a-fun-zombie-twist-on-chess-in-the-style-of-battle-chess

notes.title: Bug fix: We can do castling in Classical Chess mode
notes.content: We fixed a bug that used to prevent White side players from castling in Classical Chess mode.

notes.title: Balancing Queen vs Zombies mode
notes.content: Now Black Knights are created when your score reaches 100 in Queen vs Zombies mode

notes.title: Queen vs Zombies mode
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0Gxl9oLMCxg;full][/previewyoutube]

Pawn of the Dead has a new game mode! In Queen vs Zombies, you control White Queen, Elona. Your purpose is to prevent the undead reach the other side of the board. 

You have a magical ability this time. For every 7 undead you kill with your sword, you gain power to instantly destroy enemies in vertical, horizontal and diagonal positions.

notes.title: Instant random levels
notes.content: In this patch, the random level generator mode provides you a level instantly. We have pre-generated hundreds of levels for you. We will continue generating more levels in the future.

notes.title: New main menu music, being able to skip to the next level with "Show Solution"
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GhdamDTEuVk;full][/previewyoutube]

Pawn of the Dead has a new main menu music, thanks to my dear friend, Çağlar Şahin.

Also, when you choose "Show Solution" for a campaign level, you can skip to the next level without winning the current level by yourself.

notes.title: Optimization update
notes.content: Now if you play Pawn of the Dead on Low or Very Low quality settings, some of the environment elements (like extra light sources) become invisible. So, you can play the game with a better performance at those settings.

notes.title: We have a Discord server
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have a Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/fMZp8bf7H6]https://discord.gg/fMZp8bf7H6[/url]

My aim is to create a friendly community centered (but not limited with) our games and other indie games. Gamers, indie developers, anyone working in the industry are welcome!

notes.title: Optimization update: Post processing options
notes.content: We added some options that let you play the game with better optimization. You can turn on/off bloom and ambient occlusion now. Also, the game doesn't run in background anymore.

notes.title: You can skip the tutorial levels when you click New Game
notes.content: As the title explains, we have added a new page to the main menu that allows you to skip the tutorial levels if you click New Game

notes.title: Changed Level 1-14
notes.content: Now the undead knight isn't there in that level

notes.title: Hotfix 24.02.2021
notes.content:
[b]A1 of the board is black[/b]
We fixed the mistake that the tiles of the chess board were miscolored.

[b]New zoom control[/b]
Now you zoom the camera as if you scroll in a webpage with your mouse wheel.

notes.title: Chapter 3, Level 9 is remade
notes.content: In our first patch after the release, we fixed the Chapter 3, Level 9. Genco Seçmen let me know that the level couldn't be passed at Hardcore difficulty. Now it can be passed at all the three difficulty modes.

notes.title: Pawn of the Dead is released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/5ddf5ddebcf197f42fdc95971fe6bf16b62161df.jpg[/img]

I'm very happy to announce that Pawn of the Dead is finally released today! 

This game has been a passion project for me. We have been working on Pawn of the Dead since 2013 (of course there were some side projects during the time, like Clown House), this game has been an important aspect of my life during this time. I always wanted to make a fantasy fiction game, supported by cinematics. I made the dream come true, while some sacrifices had to be made.

I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Optimization for Town scenes
notes.content: Town scenes (in-game and cutscene scenes) have better optimization. You will be able to get higher FPS at these scenes.

notes.title: Time counter works differently now
notes.content: The counter you see while playing the campaign mode is changed. It used to show the whole time during the chapter. Now it shows only the level's time.

notes.title: Music slider
notes.content: You can change the volume of the music

notes.title: Campaign mode can be played
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/e9a83b3d02a7e44aad9779356c3b77cfba1fa3a3.jpg[/img]

As the title explains, you can test the current version of Pawn of the Dead's campaign mode right now. We have a story with 64 levels, supported by cinematics.

Also, 4 new achievements are added. They are achieved at the ends of each chapters.

[b]Story[/b]
Your mission as Leonard, the White King, is to protect the White Kingdom against the marching army of undead. Elona, the White Queen, is the best warrior in the kingdom, you won’t be able to succeed without her help. During your quest, you will face a sinister reflection that you forgot a long time ago.

[b]What's left for the full release?[/b]
We will revise the model of Black Queen.

notes.title: New AI and musics
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We updated Pawn of the Dead today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/b36ca469eca394b9bbc3c39242c468219f6d6171.png[/img]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*]The AI of the game is rewritten. Now the AI is able to predict your future moves, which means that the AI became harder. At this point, we are waiting for your feedback. 
 
[*]We have 2 new musics for Graveyard and Town scenes. This means that each environment has its own theme.
 
[*]You can change the graphic quality, resolution and V-Sync from the game. Unity's own resolution screen is removed.
 
[*]When Black side loses, you can see Black King and Black Queen flee by teleporting, while the rest of the undead pieces die.
[/list]

[h3]Our plans[/h3]
[list]
[*]We will create the campaign mode's 64 levels after we are sure that the AI satisfies you
 
[*]Black Queen model will be revised
[/list]

notes.title: December 2020 News
notes.content:
We keep working on Pawn of the Dead. I have two news.

1. Cinematics are almost completed. Turkish voice acting of Kings and revisions on some animations are all that are left. We published a video of Chapter 2's English cinematic to show you how our cinematics will be like.

[previewyoutube=3CuFp8VA0Gg;full][/previewyoutube]

2. AI will be improved. Some players enjoyed the current version of AI. But some others (especially chess players) found it too weak. So I have decided to improve it, so that we can target chess players. Casual and Normal difficulty modes will remain the same, Hardcore difficulty mode will have Minimax and alpha-prunning algorithms.

This means that the 64 levels of the campaign mode will need to be remade, because they must be beatable by the players when they play against the new AI.

I am sorry that the game will be delayed because of the new AI, but I want to release the best that Pawn of the Dead can be on full release.

notes.title: Gothic Ruins: New environment and music
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/c7d97f41faaaad2dc140bac1460e11fd0f0da0a7.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=23pGAw4CuJY;full][/previewyoutube]

Pawn of the Dead is getting closer to full release.

We have a new environment, Gothic Ruins, and a new music for that environment. It's the second music composed by Uğurcan Orçun (who is also working for TaleWorlds) for Pawn of the Dead.

notes.title: New Queen animations
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=26zvPUuXYdg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We worked on new Queen animations for Pawn of the Dead. White Queen runs on board, while Black Queen teleports herself to distant squares.

Also, I changed the color space to Linear from Gamma in Unity. I hope you like it better now.

notes.title: July 31, 2020 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/1b332ce8346eaed0d9cb3d693d83d90ae2c9e55c.jpg[/img]

* We worked on the Castle environment to make it look better
* There are short sounds at the ends of matches that show which side has won the match 
* We fixed a few bugs. For example, we weren't getting correct solutions for Casual difficulty, sometimes the game was creating levels that the enemy would win. That bug is fixed.

notes.title: Vulkan support for Linux
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33373062/28b24f0921f14d60b94e3ffa94d0c18a7fe0db52.png[/img]

You can play Pawn of the Dead on your Linux computer with Vulkan, too, now! OpenGL Core support still exists, in case you can't run Vulkan on your computer.

We have also made some minor changes on the visuals.

notes.title: 64 bit support for Mac
notes.content:
Pawn of the Dead has 64 bit support for Mac now, which means it will work for the latest macOS version (Catalina).

[b]Embrassing side-note: [/b]The game had 64 bit support for Mac since October, 2019. Today I noticed that I didn't mark the game this way in Steam, which resulted in the game seeming as if it doesn't work in Catalina. I fixed it today.

notes.title: Classical chess mode is live
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33373062/4d54c27a83fe72bde918c582c6f45f9e40b3502b.jpg[/img]

Pawn of the Dead's classical chess mode is live now, you can start playing it! FIDE rules are applied in this mode.

It is also possible to play the game with classical chess rules in random level generation mode. This means that, you can play infinite amounts of chess puzzles in Pawn of the Dead.

notes.title: Town environment is ready
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33373062/5726f9243868905b7892161a34b889ddad95c5bb.png[/img]

Town environment is ready! It took days to optimize the environment to our standards, I hope you like it.

notes.title: First 16 levels are playable
notes.content: The first 16 levels (first chapter) of Pawn of the Dead's campaign are now available! We want to hear your feedbacks, especially how long it took to complete them.

notes.title: Ctrl+Z is live
notes.content:
Hello,

Now you can undo your move with Ctrl + Z during playing Pawn of the Dead! It was the most requested feature.

notes.title: Achievements are live!
notes.content:
I have successfully added the first achievements in the game. You can see them from https://steamcommunity.com/stats/890130/achievements

I am planning to add more achievements during the early access development.

notes.title: Achievements are coming
notes.content:
Hello,

I am working on achievements. If things go smooth, you will have access to the achievements in a few days.

The achievements are mainly about how many random levels you beat.

notes.title: Linux support is live
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33373062/5f78e7bbeed5cca763a527cd8b6299fceaed2988.png[/img]

Good news for Linux users: You can play the game on your Linux natively now! No need for emulation.

I managed to solve that post-processing bug that prevented me from publishing the game for Linux. It has a minor bug now, though: At the first time I launched the game, mouse cursor didn't run. I need to launch the game twice, then everything works perfectly. I'm currently investigating the issue.

Please let us know about your Pawn of the Dead experience in Linux, I'll do my best to make it better.

notes.title: News about Linux version
notes.content:
Hello,

I have got some bad news about the Linux support for Pawn of the Dead.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33373062/59fd428f06e93970a645bb1f67108a12ae384ce1.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately, I am having technical problems with our game engine (Unity) and Linux. To be precise, post-processing image effects work extremely buggy on OpenGLCore. The game can't be shipped in this state. So I need to let you know that the Linux support will wait at this point, it will be come when we fix the problem with Unity.

I am a supporter of the concept of free software and OS's. I don't expect so much Linux players for Pawn of the Dead, but I still want to support Linux for it, like I did in Clown House and Graveyard Shift.
